name: Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. provides corporate and retail banking services in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Corporate Banking, Retail Banking and Credit Card Treasury business, and Others segments. The Corporate Banking segment offers deposits, corporate loans and advances, trade financing, agency services, consulting and advisory services, remittance, settlement services, and guarantee services to corporations, government agencies, and financial institutions. The Retail Banking and Credit Card segment provides deposits, personal loans, bank cards, personal wealth management services, and remittance services to retail customers.
